title: nf-boltz pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for protein structure prediction using Boltz-2

input_output_options.title: Input/Output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data

pred_name.description: Prediction run name. Only letters, numbers, underscores, and dashes allowed. Used as prefix for output files. e.g. protein_complex', 'antibody_design', 'my_prediction'

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved in /vast/scratch/users/$USERNAME/ e.g. 'boltz2'='/vast/scratch/users/josh/boltz2'. Existing results with the same prediction name will be overwritten.

use_outdir_prefix.description: Whether to use the outdir_prefix /vast/scratch/users/$USERNAME/. Set to false for absolute paths in --outdir.

input_yaml.description: Path to input YAML files or directory of YAML files. If provided, this will ignore all sequence, ligand, constraints, and template parameters below but will still respect affinity, prediction and compute options.
input_yaml.help_text: e.g. '/path/to/input.yaml' '/path/to/inputdir'. The name of each yaml file will be used for the prediction name.

diffusion_samples.help_text: More samples improve quality but increase computation time. Default: 1

use_potentials.description: Whether to use potentials to improve the physical quality of the predictions (a.k.a. Boltz-2x)

method.description: Method conditioning to use for prediction.
method.help_text: Choose from: 'afdb', 'boltz-1', 'md', 'electron microscopy', 'solution-nmr', 'x-ray diffraction', or 'other'. 'Other' includes methods that are treated equivalently such as electron crystallography, epr, fiber diffraction, fluorescence transfer, infrared spectroscopy, neutron diffraction, powder diffraction, solution scattering, solid-state nmr, theoretical model

recycling_steps.help_text: More steps generally improve accuracy but increase computation time. Default = 3.

sampling_steps.help_text: Number of denoising steps in the diffusion process. Default: 200

step_scale.help_text: The step scale is related to the temperature at which the diffusion process samples the distribution. The lower the higher the diversity among samples (recommended between 1 and 2, default=1.638)

output_format.description: Output format for structure predictions. Default: mmcif

write_full_pae.description: Whether to save the full PAE matrix as a file

write_full_pde.description: Whether to save the full PDE matrix as a file

extra_config.help_text: Extra command-line arguments for Boltz-2 (e.g., '--msa_pairing_strategy complete --confidence_threshold 0.7')

sequence_1_options.title: Sequence 1 options
sequence_1_options.description: Configure sequence 1 (protein, DNA or RNA chain)

seq1_seq.description: Sequence 1: amino acid/nucleotide sequence e.g., 'MDYK...' or 'ATGGTT...'

seq1_chain_id.description: Sequence 1: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'A' or '1') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'A,B,C').

seq1_genmsa.description: Generate MSA for sequence 1 (only applies to protein sequences).

seq1_cyclic.description: Is sequence 1 cyclic? Set to true for cyclic peptides/DNA/RNA.

sequence_2_options.title: Sequence 2 options
sequence_2_options.description: Configure sequence 2 (protein, DNA or RNA chain)

seq2_seq.description: Sequence 2: amino acid/nucleotide sequence e.g., 'MDYK...' or 'ATGGTT...'

seq2_chain_id.description: Sequence 2: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'A' or '1') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'A,B,C').

seq2_genmsa.description: Generate MSA for sequence 2 (only applies to protein sequences).

seq2_cyclic.description: Is sequence 2 cyclic? Set to true for cyclic peptides/DNA/RNA.

sequence_3_options.title: Sequence 3 options
sequence_3_options.description: Configure sequence 3 (protein, DNA or RNA chain)

seq3_seq.description: Sequence 3: amino acid/nucleotide sequence e.g., 'MDYK...' or 'ATGGTT...'

seq3_chain_id.description: Sequence 3: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'A' or '1') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'A,B,C').

seq3_genmsa.description: Generate MSA for sequence 3 (only applies to protein sequences).

seq3_cyclic.description: Is sequence 3 cyclic? Set to true for cyclic peptides/DNA/RNA.

sequence_4_options.title: Sequence 4 options
sequence_4_options.description: Configure sequence 4 (protein, DNA or RNA chain)

seq4_seq.description: Sequence 4: amino acid/nucleotide sequence e.g., 'MDYK...' or 'ATGGTT...'

seq4_chain_id.description: Sequence 4: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'A' or '1') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'A,B,C').

seq4_genmsa.description: Generate MSA for sequence 4 (only applies to protein sequences).

seq4_cyclic.description: Is sequence 4 cyclic? Set to true for cyclic peptides/DNA/RNA.

sequences_extra_options.title: Extra sequences (advanced)
sequences_extra_options.description: Add additional input sequences here. Format: space separated blocks: [ID(s)][SEQUENCE] [ID(s)][SEQUENCE] ...

sequences_extra.help_text: Extra sequences in block format: [IDs][SEQUENCE] [IDs][SEQUENCE] ... IDs = comma separated for multi-chain. Sequence type is auto-detected (DNA>RNA>Protein). Example: '[E][MAAAD] [F,G][ACTGACTG]'. No modifications or cyclic sequences. MSA will be automatically generated for protein sequences

lig1_chain_id.description: Ligand 1: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'D' or '2') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'G,H').

lig1_ccd.description: Ligand 1: CCD code. E.g. 'ZN', 'ATP'. Ignored if SMILES is provided.

lig1_smiles.description: Ligand 1: SMILES string e.g. '[Ca+2]', 'CCO', 'C1CCCCC1'. If provided, CCD is ignored.

lig2_chain_id.description: Ligand 2: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'D' or '2') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'G,H').

lig2_ccd.description: Ligand 2: CCD code. E.g. 'ZN', 'ATP'. Ignored if SMILES is provided.

lig2_smiles.description: Ligand 2: SMILES string e.g. '[Ca+2]', 'CCO', 'C1CCCCC1'. If provided, CCD is ignored.

lig3_chain_id.description: Ligand 3: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'D' or '2') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'G,H').

lig3_ccd.description: Ligand 3: CCD code. E.g. 'ZN', 'ATP'. Ignored if SMILES is provided.

lig3_smiles.description: Ligand 3: SMILES string e.g. '[Ca+2]', 'CCO', 'C1CCCCC1'. If provided, CCD is ignored.

lig4_chain_id.description: Ligand 4: unique chain ID(s). Single alphanumeric id (e.g. 'D' or '2') or comma-separated list for multiple copies (e.g. 'G,H').

lig4_ccd.description: Ligand 4: CCD code. E.g. 'ZN', 'ATP'. Ignored if SMILES is provided.

lig4_smiles.description: Ligand 4: SMILES string e.g. '[Ca+2]', 'CCO', 'C1CCCCC1'. If provided, CCD is ignored.

ligands_extra_options.title: Extra ligands (advanced)
ligands_extra_options.description: Add additional ligands here. Format: space separated blocks: [ID(s)][CCD][SMILES] [ID(s)][CCD][SMILES] ...

ligands_extra.help_text: Extra ligands: space separated blocks: [IDs][CCD][SMILES]. IDs: comma-separated for multiple copies. For SMILES only, leave CCD blank '[E][][C1CCCCC1]'; for CCD only, leave SMILES blank. Example: '[H][ZN][] [I][][N[C@@H](Cc1ccc(O)cc1)C(=O)O]'

affinity_ligand_id.description: Single chain ID of ligand for affinity calculations. If not specified, defaults to ligand 1 ID. e.g. 'E', 'L1', 'D'

affinity_mw_correction.description: Whether to add the Molecular Weight correction to the affinity value head.

diffusion_samples_affinity.description: The number of diffusion samples to use for affinity prediction.
diffusion_samples_affinity.help_text: More samples improve quality but increase computation time. Default: 5

sampling_steps_affinity.description: Number of sampling steps for affinity prediction

constraint_options.title: Constraint options
constraint_options.description: Define structural constraints and binding pockets

constraints_bond.description: Bond constraints. Each bond constraint is provided as a pair of atoms. Multiple bonds can be specified, seperated by spaces.
constraints_bond.help_text: For both atoms that form each bond, provide the chain ID, res number, and atom name. Format: '[CHAIN_ID, RES_IDX, ATOM_NAME][CHAIN_ID, RES_IDX, ATOM_NAME] [CHAIN_ID,RES_IDX, ATOM_NAME][CHAIN_ID, RES_IDX, ATOM_NAME]...' e.g. '[A,33,O][B,1,N] [H,95,SG][L,23,SG]'

constraints_contacts.description: Contact constraints provided as pairs of residues or atoms. Multiple contacts can be specified, separated by spaces.
constraints_contacts.help_text: Multiple contacts as pairs of atoms/residues: '[CHAIN_ID,RES_IDX/ATOM][CHAIN_ID,RES_IDX/ATOM][DIST][FORCE]'. E.g. '[A,53][A,57] [A,101][A,130][5][true]'. Max distance (Angstroms, default: 6) and force (default: false) are optional.

constraints_pocket1_binder.help_text: Chain ID of ligand or binder for pocket 1. E.g. 'B'.

constraints_pocket1_max_distance.help_text: Maximum distance in Å between binder and contact sites. Default 6.0 if omitted.

constraints_pocket1_force.help_text: Whether to enforce a restraint potential for pocket 1.

constraints_pocket2_binder.help_text: Chain ID of ligand or binder for pocket 2. E.g. 'C'.

constraints_pocket2_max_distance.help_text: Maximum distance in Å between binder and contact sites. Default 6.0 if omitted.

constraints_pocket2_force.help_text: Whether to enforce a restraint potential for pocket 2.

constraints_pocket_extra.description: Advanced or extra pocket constraints (block format)
constraints_pocket_extra.help_text: For advanced use, specify additional pockets with space-separated '[BINDER][[CONTACTS]][DIST][FORCE]'. Example: '[D][[A,5],[B,12]] [E][[B,99],[C,1]][4][true]'. Usually not required unless >2 pockets needed.

template1_pdb_code.description: PDB code for template 1 (auto-download CIF from RCSB)
template1_pdb_code.help_text: Specify a 4-character PDB code to download the template structure automatically.

template1_path.description: Path to template 1 CIF file. Alternative to PDB code.

template1_prediction_id.help_text: Comma-separated. E.g. 'A,B'. Leave blank to use all chains.

template1_template_id.help_text: Comma-separated. E.g. 'X,Y'. Leave blank to use all template chains.

template1_threshold.help_text: If provided, enables potential to keep prediction close to template #1 within N Å.

template2_pdb_code.description: PDB code for template 2 (auto-download CIF from RCSB)
template2_pdb_code.help_text: Specify a 4-character PDB code to download the template structure automatically.

template2_path.description: Path to template 2 CIF file. Alternative to PDB code.

template2_prediction_id.help_text: Comma-separated. E.g. 'A,B'. Leave blank to use all chains.

template2_template_id.help_text: Comma-separated. E.g. 'X,Y'. Leave blank to use all template chains.

template2_threshold.help_text: If provided, enables potential to keep prediction close to template #2 within N Å.

template_extra.help_text: Specify additional templates as blocks: '[PDBCODE][PREDICTION_IDs][TEMPLATE_IDs][THRESHOLD]'. Example: '[1ATP][A][X][5] [4HHB][B][Y][4]'. Only 4-character PDB codes (no file paths) are accepted in template_extra; CIF will be auto-downloaded and staged.

gpu_model.help_text: Choose GPU model based on availability and computational requirements

n_cpus.help_text: Number of CPU cores to allocate
